years = [0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8]  # [redacted]-1998
# Department of Agriculture total outlays (col 3), millions of dollars
# Available: 1994=60812,1995=56667,1996=54338,1997=52558,1998=53949
# Need [redacted]-1993 too, but only 1994-1998 present in excerpts.
# We only have 1994-1998. But question asks [redacted]-1998.
# Using available data 1994-1998 mapped to actual years.
data = {
    1994: 60812,
    1995: 56667,
    1996: 54338,
    1997: 52558,
    1998: 53949,
}
xs = [yr-[redacted] for yr in data]
ys = list(data.values())
n = len(xs)
mx = sum(xs)/n
my = sum(ys)/n
slope = sum((x-mx)*(y-my) for x,y in zip(xs,ys))/sum((x-mx)**2 for x in xs)
intercept = my - slope*mx
pred = slope*9 + intercept
print(f"[{round(slope,2)}, {round(intercept)}, {round(pred)}]")
